name: zk-time-decay-voting
description: Privacy-preserving voting with time-decaying weight using zk-SNARKs (Groth16)

scripts.circuit:verifier: snarkjs groth16 setup build/circuits/vote.r1cs build/circuits/pot16_final.ptau build/circuits/vote_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute build/circuits/vote_0000.zkey build/circuits/vote_final.zkey --name="hackathon" -v && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/circuits/vote_final.zkey build/circuits/verification_key.json && snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/circuits/vote_final.zkey contracts/Groth16Verifier.sol
